1377933546933907456.a: Scientific study of development instructs us when we must build certain aspects of these neural structures. Children want to try and learn everything all at once. If mentors react incorrectly to limit testing kids learn dangerous behaviors before they learn how to spot danger.

1377933547894411264.a: A child will test a trusted adult with a potentially dangerous behavior and may deem it safe and pleasurable. Then they mistakenly test a dangerous human with the same behavior and become permanently injured. I don't believe RMS himself ever learned to differentiate the danger.

1377933548838084608.a: Without this differentiation a person becomes mentally borderline. They are like Humpty Dumpty. 1377935077682900995.a: Alice would come along now and then and attempt to explain the danger to Humpty Dumpty and try to understand why he doesn't see the danger. He would cut her off, "Boring, you're boring, I'm bored, go away."
